rationale: The plan correctly blocks on subject in a single ~ subject + condition DESeq2 fit with control as reference and extracts all three pairwise contrasts, but it omits the reference's first step, an omnibus LRT against the reduced ~ subject model (or joint F-test), so the 'any condition effect' question is never tested directly. QC is thorough (library sizes, VST PCA by subject and condition, correlation heatmap, explicit no-silent-drop policy) and the filter is minimal and justified by group size. Normalization is never named: nothing says size factors or TMM are estimated inside the model, which the criterion requires to be stated. BH at 0.05 and apeglm shrinkage are explicit, though the B-vs-A contrast is left unshrunken rather than using ashr; the fgsea step names the collection and version and the Wald ranking metric but states no min/max set-size window. Reporting is complete with versions, df, thresholds, gene counts and design caveats.
